title: pid-core public Rust API signature revision registry

append_policy.description: Within the HEAD-reachable history that the presented repository lets the checker traverse after Git reports --is-shallow-repository=false, every registry state at a registry-touch commit is an immutable prefix and one semantically meaningful contiguous entry may be appended at the source-to-evidence or committed-HEAD-to-working-tree boundary. Git's non-shallow report does not establish local object completeness or exclude promisor-backed objects. After a registry entry first binds a snapshot path on an ancestor lineage, that path has the registered exact byte digest at every binding, HEAD/direct-parent boundary, and HEAD-reachable full-path-history touch state on that lineage. Pre-binding states and paths first bound only in the current working tree remain outside the historical interval. Revision 0-4 additionally requires all nine physical snapshots to have one common unique first-add commit whose sole parent is its exact source commit; ten logical activations remain distinct, with all-features and experimental-all sharing bytes only after independent equality. Never-merged unreachable branches, deleted references, externally replaced history, and unavailable promised objects remain outside these claims.

snapshotGeneration.description: The original generation host, explicit rustdoc target, and tools used to generate declaration snapshots for this entry.

snapshot_source_commit_sha.description: The code commit whose public Rust declarations were generated; the snapshot evidence bytes are retained separately and need not exist in this source commit.

snapshot_source_tree_sha.description: The code tree whose public Rust declarations were generated; it identifies source input, not a tree expected to contain the retained snapshot evidence bytes.
